units.text: It loads PSD and PSB files, reads header and layer metadata, modifies layer properties such as name, visibility, and opacity, and saves the modified files back to disk.

It loads RGB PSD and PSB documents from a file path with PsdImage.load(String) or from a stream with PsdImage.load(InputStream), reads header properties such as width, height, bits per channel, color mode, compression, and channel count, and supports RGB, CMYK and indexed-color PSD files without requiring Photoshop.
It inspects layer metadata by exposing each layer through PsdImage.getLayers, reporting the layer name, visibility, opacity, clipping, blend mode key, and position coordinates.

It edits layer metadata by allowing name, visibility, and opacity changes via setName, setVisible, and setOpacity, and writes position, clipping, and blend-mode properties while preserving the layer's pixel data.

It preserves raw file content by saving documents with a raw-preserving strategy such that documents saved without changes are identical to the file that was loaded, and unedited sections are copied through unchanged.
It lists image resources through getImageResources, exposing each resource's id, name, and size, while preserving their payloads on save without exposing their internal data.
It handles multiple color modes by supporting RGB, CMYK and indexed-color PSD files during load and save operations.

The PsdImage class serves as the library's entry point for loading and saving PSD files, and it returns Layer instances through its getLayers method. Layer provides access to editable per-layer metadata such as name, visibility, and opacity.
